title: imperatoria ostruthium var. angustifolia
intro: Imperatoria ostruthium var. angustifolia, commonly known as Wild Angelica, is a perennial plant in the Apiaceae family, known for its tall stems and umbrella-like inflorescence. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. Its therapeutic actions include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for relieving respiratory issues and soothing skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Wild Angelica include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
